question: How do I start a conversation?
answer: Simply type your message in the text box on the Home screen and tap the send icon. iChatAI will respond instantly using the selected AI model.

question: What models does iChatAI use?
answer: We leverage a variety of high-performance models through OpenRouter, including free and premium versions of Gemini, Mistral, and GPT-based models to ensure the best response quality.

question: Is iChatAI free to use?
answer: Yes! You start with a set of free credits. You can earn more by watching ads, checking in daily, or performing specific tasks within the app.

question: How does the credit system work?
answer: Each message sent to the AI consumes 1 credit. You can check your balance in the 'Credits' screen. Credits are automatically deducted upon successful response.

question: How do I earn more credits?
answer: You can earn credits by completing daily check-ins or by watching rewarded video ads. Tapping the '+' icon next to your credit balance will show all available options.

question: Are there any subscription plans?
answer: Paid subscriptions with unlimited messaging and priority access to faster models are coming soon! Keep an eye on the 'Subscription' screen for updates.

question: How do I update my profile?
answer: Navigate to Settings > User Profile. Here you can change your display name, email, and avatar icon to personalize your experience.

question: Can the AI analyze images?
answer: Yes! Tap the image icon (camera) in the chat input bar to upload or take a photo. You can then ask the AI questions about the image's content.

question: How do I save my favorite prompts?
answer: You can save frequently used prompts in the 'Saved Prompts' section from the navigation drawer. This allows you to quickly re-use complex instructions.

question: How do I pin or delete chats?
answer: In the 'Chat History' screen, long-press any chat session to see options for pinning it to the top or deleting it permanently.

question: Is my conversation history private?
answer: Absolutely. Your chats are stored locally on your device using a Room database. We do not store your private conversations on our servers.

question: Why is the AI not responding?
answer: Ensure you have a stable internet connection and remaining credits. If you see a timeout error, the AI model might be temporarily overloaded—please try again in a moment.

question: Cloud Sync is failing, what should I do?
answer: Make sure you have granted the app permission to access Google Drive. Check your Google Account storage limits and ensure you have a valid network connection.

question: How do I clear the app cache?
answer: You can clear the app's internal cache via Settings > Data & Storage Management. This can help resolve minor performance issues without deleting your chats.

question: I found a bug, how can I report it?
answer: We'd love to hear from you! Report it via Feedback or Tap the 'Live Chat' button at the bottom of the Help Center to send us a message directly via WhatsApp.
